header.description: Graphical map (stock): MapStartMapping, MapActivateCell and MapMapExits of frmMain and frmMap, MapGoDirection, cmdMove_Click and cmdMapLeadsHere_Click.
notes: Steps run MME's own procedures cut from frmMain.frm and frmMap.frm (frmMap's are renamed with the prefix W so both copies load). MapDrawOnRoom is a recorder; `m.draws` lists its calls since picMap.Cls as cell << 12 | shape << 8 | size << 4 | QBColor, `m.cells` is [cell, map, room, UnchartedCells, BackColor] for every cell that holds a room or has a colour, `m.alts` the ALT_ copies, `m.was` [cell, map, room] for each overwritten-room tooltip.
ids: m-* run frmMain's grid, w<size>-* frmMap at that cmbMapSize entry. The surface is the case's `surface`; forms.frmMain.name is `frmMain` or `frmMap` (MapMapExits asks).
go-main steps record where MapGoDirection would call MapStartMapping (event kind call MapRecGo) or its message box; go-win-* do the same for cmdMove_Click.
leads-*: frmResults.lvResults is a recording list; the database holds the rooms, monsters, spells and textblocks in data (db_only).
The Rooms table is the subset the cases reach (db_only pairs); data.rooms is the same rows for the Rust test. Rows numbered 9001 and up are invented.
data.presets is the (name, map, room) list of LoadPresets' defaults, read from MME's source by pattern.
